text.tspan: Sources (left) are read by the tools (middle), which write the files of the repository (right); the analysis and the public site are built from them. A routine runs the tools on weekdays at
05:15 UTC and merges its pull request once the checks pass; a second one builds and publishes this site every day at 06:47 UTC.
Publications Office: acts, proposals, corrigenda (SPARQL, XHTML), procedure files
documents and public PDFs, public agendas of the working parties

Open Data API (documents, committees, rapporteurs), Legislative Observatory
consultations, drafts for feedback, feedback by organisations
delegated and implementing acts in preparation
committees: meetings, agendas, drafts, votes, summary records
expert groups: meetings, minutes, members, publications
groups set up by an act (NIS Cooperation Group)
eNorm and Register of Commission documents
projects of the technical bodies (public pages)
Drucksachen: bills with explanatory memorandum, committee reports
